title: The Secret door in the wall
subtitle: 文学写作 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 文学写作（人与社会·文学艺术与体育·文学与写作）
meta: 主题语境：文学写作（人与社会·文学艺术与体育·文学与写作）　|　核心词汇：secret　|　正文 347 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 secret 的用法与含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1948 the builder wrote of ① a secret door in the wall in the plan, and everybody in the site said at once that it was ② so secret that nobody in the site would go near it. Three months on, people still spoke of that morning, and of how the builder, who never explained anything, had done it with great care and gone home; it was the secret ones, my mother said, that people remembered longest.

It was ③ the secret door in the wall that anybody there had ever seen, or so the plan for October 1942 claims. My mother, who had seen them all, thought it ④ too secret to be of any use to anybody, and said as much to the assistant who had come to help; the secret ones, she used to say, were never the useful ones.

My uncle, who kept the beam at the far wall, meant something else entirely. He called the whole business ⑤ a secret meeting of the two men, and said that no assistant in his right mind would call it ⑥ as secret as the meeting of the two men they had once had in the old site. He was never a man who cared whether a thing was secret or not, and he said so.

By 1955 the matter had shrunk to half a line in the plan. What the line asked for was ⑦ something secret, and nothing besides. The assistant from the next site called the whole plan ⑧ quite secret; everybody laughed, and then did exactly what he had said. After that the plan kept the names of the secret ones only.

My mother said nothing at all. In 1958, on the same day, she wrote of another secret door in the wall in the same plan, and the work, which took two months, seemed ⑨ no less secret than anybody had expected. ⑩ The secret meeting of the two men that nobody had wanted to name, she said in 1960, was the one she could never quite name; the secret ones, she added, are always the ones that stay.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请为文中十处画线形式选择对应的用法说明。
options: A. adj. 秘密（前置定语 a secret door in the wall：1948 年施工员在施工图里记下的那件秘密的暗门）
B. adj. 秘密／暗中（两处加强说法：so secret that … 与 no less secret than …）
C. adj. 秘密／暗中（两处定语从句式的最高级说法，见第 3、10 题）
D. adj. 秘密（表语 too secret to do：母亲觉得它太秘密，反倒派不上用场）
E. adj. 暗中（前置定语 a secret meeting of the two men：叔叔把整件事称作一桩暗中的秘密会面）
F. adj. 暗中（同级比较 as secret as：拿眼前这桩跟旧日那桩两人的秘密会面相比）
G. adj. 暗中（后置定语 something secret：修饰不定代词时须放在其后）
H. adj. 暗中（受程度副词修饰 quite secret：那位帮工的评价）

items.q: a secret door in the wall
the secret door in the wall that
a secret meeting of the two men
The secret meeting of the two men that

answers.why: secret 意为“秘密”，1948 年施工员在施工图里记下的是“一件秘密的暗门”，此处作前置定语 a secret door in the wall。
secret 意为“秘密”，此处用 so secret that 结构，说它秘密到工地里没人敢靠近。
secret 意为“秘密”，施工图上 十月 那行字说那是当地人从未见过的秘密墙上的暗门，等于最高级的说法。
secret 意为“秘密”，母亲认为这件东西“太秘密了，谁也用不上”，too secret to do 表示“太……以致不能”。
secret 意为“暗中”，叔叔把整件事称作“一桩暗中的秘密会面”，此处作前置定语 a secret meeting of the two men。
secret 意为“暗中”，叔叔不肯说它“跟旧日那桩两人的秘密会面一样暗中”，同级比较用 as secret as。
secret 意为“暗中”，施工图上那半行字要的是“暗中的东西”，something 被形容词修饰时形容词须后置：something secret。
secret 意为“暗中”，邻工地来的那位帮工认为这套计划“相当暗中”，quite 修饰原级 secret。
secret 意为“暗中”，no less secret than 表示“其暗中不亚于……”，此处说这趟活儿之暗中不亚于任何人的预料。
secret 意为“暗中”，母亲 1960 年说的是“那桩她始终叫不出名字的暗中秘密会面”，that 从句限定到极致。

task2.title: Task 2　语境运用
task2.intro: 请把下列句子译成英文，括号里是必须用到的形式。
items: 1948 年，施工员在施工图里记下了一件秘密的暗门。（a secret door in the wall）
它秘密到工地里没有一个人敢靠近。（so secret that …）
母亲觉得它太秘密，谁也用不上。（too secret to …）
叔叔把整件事称作一桩暗中的秘密会面。（a secret meeting of the two men）
他说，谁也不会认为它跟旧日那桩两人的秘密会面一样暗中。（as secret as …）
到了 1955 年，施工图上只剩半行字：要的是一件暗中的东西。（something secret）
answers: In 1948 the builder wrote of a secret door in the wall in the plan.
It was so secret that nobody in the site would go near it.
My mother thought it too secret to be of any use to anybody.
My uncle called the whole business a secret meeting of the two men.
He said nobody would call it as secret as the meeting of the two men they had once had.
By 1955 the plan asked for nothing but something secret.

task3.title: Task 3　语境写作
task3.intro: 请写 5—6 个句子，至少使用 secret 的 3 种不同用法（前置定语、表语、比较级／最高级、后置定语等）；至少使用下列词语中的 3 个。
answers: In 1948 the builder wrote of a secret door in the wall in the plan, and nobody forgot it.
It was the secret door in the wall that anybody there had ever seen, or so the plan says.
My mother thought it too secret to be of any use, and said so plainly.
My uncle called the whole business a secret meeting of the two men, and nobody argued with him.
The assistant from the next site called the plan quite secret, and everybody laughed.
The secret ones, my mother said, are always the ones that stay.
